page.content:
Desert town of radio, angels, a forbidden dog park, and a glowing cloud.

How Night Vale connects

  • Work: Welcome to Night Vale (show) — The show reports from, and is about, the town of Night Vale.
  • Faction: Night Vale Community Radio — Night Vale Community Radio broadcasts from the town of Night Vale.
  • Character: Cecil Palmer — Cecil Palmer lives in and narrates Night Vale.
  • Location: the dog park — The forbidden dog park sits inside Night Vale.

  • Faction: Night Vale City Council — The City Council issues the edicts that govern Night Vale.
  • Concept: the Glow Cloud — The Glow Cloud hangs over Night Vale and later sits on its council.
  • Location: Desert Bluffs — Desert Bluffs is Night Vale's smiling sister city across the sand.
  • Faction: StrexCorp Synernists Inc. — Night Vale resists StrexCorp's attempt to buy the town and the station.

  • Faction: angels — The angels occupy Josie's land in Night Vale.

  • Work: Welcome to Night Vale (novel) — The novel is still set in the town of Night Vale.
  • Concept: wheat and wheat by-products — Wheat and wheat by-products are Night Vale's staple and running sponsor.

What is Night Vale?

Night Vale is the American-southwest desert community Cecil reports on: a City Council that may be lizards, a Sheriff's Secret Police, a dog park no one may discuss, and weather that is not weather.

Key threads lead to Welcome to Night Vale (show), Night Vale Community Radio, Cecil Palmer, the dog park, Carlos the Scientist and Night Vale City Council.
